name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
label: Quest
description: A notice announces that Taskmaster Scrange wants some capable hands to cull the competition in the Searing Gorge. The work is slaying Dark Iron…
intro: A notice announces that Taskmaster Scrange wants some capable hands to cull the competition in the Searing Gorge. The work is slaying Dark Iron Taskmasters and Dark Iron Slavers until your clothes are bloody enough, then returning to Scrange.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the Searing Gorge.
If you are interested in this position, venture out into the Searing Gorge and slaughter every Dark Iron Taskmaster and Dark Iron Slaver that you see.
Return to Taskmaster Scrange when your clothes are bloody enough.
You'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We're gonna need to weigh you with and without clothes to be sure.

clips.title: Completion
paras: 15.9 pounds! That may be a new record for blood and gut weight on apparel! Congratulations, adventurer!
